title: Trump Moves Ahead With F-35 Jet Sales to Saudi Arabia Despite Intelligence Concerns
summary: U.S. intelligence agencies have warned in internal reports that China could acquire or steal U.S. warplane technology if F-35 jets are sent to Saudi Arabia.
body_markdown: U.S. intelligence agencies have warned in internal reports that China could acquire or steal U.S. warplane technology if F-35 jets are sent to Saudi Arabia.
